name: grid_survey
summary: Read the grid before routing: the 2 m cells of a box or a room, a page at a time (8 cells), by what occupies each (cell_detail full adds support and ids), the pieces, devices and their ports, and networks. Read only.

help.text: Pieces and devices are those in the page's cells, so a device spanning pages is listed on each. A page lists at most 40 pieces and 20 devices by default; truncated gives how many, list_limits {"pieces": n, "devices": n} lists more. Cells come by what occupies them; cell_detail full gives each in full. sections, network_ids, kinds, prefab(s), prefab_contains and occupied_only narrow it.
help.keys: legend, cells [{at, empty, frame_id, faces, small; room_id, frame, walls, support}], count, offset, limit, total, has_more, pieces [{reference_id, kind, prefab_name, at, cell_count, cell_box, cells, ends, ...}], devices [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, at, rotation, ports, umbilical}], networks, network_visibility [{network_id, kind, pieces, cells, air_at, refund}], doors [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, faces, plane, band_m, port_cells}], resolved_networks.

cells.text: Default (cell_detail occupancy): at (its centre, odd metres), empty (true when it holds nothing: no frame, face structure or small-grid thing), frame_id, faces (6 characters, +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z: '.' none, 'w' wall, 'g' window, 'x' door; left out when all '.'), small (left out when all '.'). cell_detail full: at, room_id, frame {reference_id, prefab_name, build_state, build_states, blocks_air, blocks_gravity}, walls [{face, reference_id, prefab_name, blocks_air}], small and support: 64 characters for its 0.5 m cells at -1, -0.5, 0, +0.5 m on each axis, index x + 4y + 16z. small: '.' empty, 'c' cable, 'p' pipe, 'b' both, 'h' chute, 'd' device, 'o' another small-grid thing, 'r' a rocket's empty cell. support: 'i' inside a frame, 'e' a frame edge or corner, 'f' on a frame's face, 'w' on a wall's plane, 'a' air, 'x' a door's keep-out, 'g' a window.

pieces.text: pieces [{reference_id, kind, prefab_name, at, cell_count and cell_box {min, max, size} (a piece filling more than one small cell; cells lists each with include_piece_cells), ends, network_id, grade; chutes also flow {in, out} and carries}]. devices [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, at, rotation {facing, up, euler}, ports [{index, at (the cell a piece joining it stands in), toward (the end that piece needs), type, role, network_id}], umbilical}].

networks.text: networks (include_networks, default true): cable networks with loads and lowest ratings, pipe networks with contents, pressure and gases, chute networks with chute_count, riding items and devices. network_visibility [{network_id, kind, pieces, cells {inside, frame_surface, wall, air}, air_at, refund}]. include_refund adds each piece's refund and each network's total, what remove_* would give back.

rules.text: Frames and walls never block cables or pipes, so runs may pass through frame cells and along wall planes. A device, chute or other small-grid thing blocks both. A pipe blocks a cable only along its own axis, and the other way round. A chute is blocked by any cable, pipe, device, chute or other thing in its cell.

min.description: Box corner, [x, y, z] in metres; with max.

max.description: The other corner; at most 20000 2 m cells.

room_id.description: A room id (rooms), instead of a box.

include_networks.description: Include the networks of the pieces. Default true.

include_refund.description: Add each piece's removal refund and each network's total. Default false.

sections.description: Only these parts: cells, pieces, devices, networks, network_visibility, doors; default all.

network_ids.description: Only pieces on these networks (ids or pieces) and devices with a port on one.

kinds.description: Only pieces of these kinds (cable, pipe, chute) and devices with such a port.

prefab.description: Only pieces and devices of this whole prefab name, any case ('StructurePipeStraight'); with prefab_contains both must match.

prefab_contains.description: Only pieces and devices whose prefab name holds this, any case ('Insulated', 'Junction', 'Pump').

cell_detail.description: occupancy (default): each cell's frame id, faces and small strings. full: also room, frame state, wall ids, support.

occupied_only.description: Only cells holding something (frame, wall, small-grid thing). Default false.

include_piece_cells.description: Every small cell of a long piece, not just cell_count and cell_box.

limit.description: 2 m cells per page; default 8, max 125.

x-paging.order: 2 m cells by y, then z, then x (lowest first); pieces and devices are those in the page's cells
